description: This Java class functions as a Spring MVC Controller for managing store branding functionalities in an admin interface, including branding display, logo upload, store template change, and logo removal.

classes.name: StoreBrandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling store branding related operations such as displaying branding page, saving branding details, updating templates, and removing images.

methods.name: displayStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store branding management page, populates model attributes with store info and templates.

methods.name: saveStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a store's branding logo image, uploads the image, and updates the store record.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to change the store's template setting and persist the change.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete the store's logo image and update the store record accordingly.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method for setting menu-related model attributes for UI navigation.
